description: Book Report imports and organizes your sales data from Kindle Direct Publishing, Draft2Digital, and many more leading book publishing platforms. With this app, you can give ChatGPT access to that sales data. It can summarize trends, compare time periods, identify top books and series, break down earnings by distributor or marketplace, answer follow-up questions, and much more. Instead of clicking around to find the data you need, you can get it simply by asking. Access is read-only: the app can retrieve reports and catalog context, but cannot modify Book Report data, accounts, or connected publishing accounts.
